import hopsworks
import pandas as pd

# Connect to Hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Read the prediction log
prediction_log = pd.read_csv('data/prediction_log.csv')

# Create a feature group for the prediction logs
fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='prediction_logs',
    version=1,
    description='Logged predictions from a deployed model',
    primary_key=['ts'],
    event_time='ts',
    online_enabled=False,
    statistics_config={'enabled': True, 'histograms': True, 'correlations': True}
)

# Save the data to the feature group
fg.save(prediction_log)

# Enable monitoring for distribution shift
fg.enable_monitoring(
    name='prediction_distribution_shift',
    feature_name='prediction',
    description='Monitor prediction distribution for shifts',
    window_config={'time_offset': '30d', 'window_length': '1d'}
)

# Fetch the monitoring results to identify the shift
monitoring_results = fg.get_monitoring_results()
print('Monitoring results:', monitoring_results)

# Identify the onset date of the shift
# The monitoring results should contain the date of the detected shift
# For this task, we assume the first detected shift is the answer
onset_date = None
